text: Steenbarger: the room agrees on a turn out of the ma_20 pullback; minervini, raschke, wyckoff and seow each name a turn or reclaim, not the dip. I concede that form: R8 is Elder's dip-and-reclaim, and elder_5d [10,10,7,7,10] CORRECTION_REENTRY with mp_state STRONG is a reclaim. So reclaim:ma_20 on H1, an hourly close back above the 20-day, keeps my entry at value. I do not take a fresh closing high: that buys in front of price (C10). W LH/LL is a weaker tide (C21). Wrong if elder prints red or a daily close below base_low_20d.
